{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# HANDOFF - cachetools milestone 1

## Deliverable
`src/cachetools/tagged.py` implements `TaggedCache(maxsize)`, backed by
`cachetools.LRUCache` (via a private `_TaggedLRUCache` subclass that reports
evicted keys so tag memberships are cleaned up on eviction).

## Requirements status
- R01: put(key, value, tags=()) inserts/replaces; deep-copies values on input
  and get(); get() returns detached deep copy, KeyError on miss; tags must be
  a finite iterable of strings (bare str rejected, non-str entries rejected
  with ValueError, deduplicated, order preserved); all validation happens
  before any state mutation.
- R02: invalidate(tag) removes exactly entries carrying the tag and returns
  count; replacement removes old tag memberships; LRU eviction cleans
  memberships (no stale reuse); get() refreshes recency; len() counts live
  entries.
- R03: maxsize must be a positive int excluding bool (ValueError otherwise);
  invalid replacement input leaves old value/tags/recency unchanged (verified
  by tests); every value costs exactly one capacity slot.
- Claim-A extension (put_no_recency_refresh variant): overwriting an existing
  key via put refreshes LRU recency (it becomes MRU). Implemented and tested
  (test_replacement_refreshes_recency, test_replacement_refreshes_recency_with_tag_change).

## Design notes
- Internal state: `self.__data` (LRU storage), `self.__tags` (key -> tuple of
  tags), `self.__memberships` (tag -> list of keys).
- put() order: normalize tags -> hash-check key -> deepcopy value -> if
  existing: remove old memberships BEFORE LRU update (so an eviction during
  the update can never resurrect stale memberships) -> assign value/tags ->
  add new memberships. LRU __setitem__ moves key to MRU for both insert and
  replace.
- _TaggedLRUCache.popitem() calls self._on_evict(key) after LRUCache.popitem
  so evicted keys lose tag/tag-membership records.
- Also provides mapping-style helpers: __getitem__ (deep copy, refreshes
  recency), __delitem__, pop(key, default), clear(), maxsize/currsize
  properties, __contains__, __len__, __repr__.

## Tests
- Own tests: tests/test_tagged.py (23 tests, all pass).
- Public acceptance: acceptance_public.py (2 tests, pass).
- Upstream tests: tests/ (237 pass total incl. tagged; upstream files
  unchanged - git status shows only new files tagged.py/test_tagged.py).

Run: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q`
EOF
echo handoff-written"}
